name: Malchus
background: The confidential agent of Caiaphas. He was healed by Jesus after Peter struck him in Gethsemane, leaving him in a state of profound cognitive dissonance.

genericReactions.physical: This... this is from that night. I remember the cold steel.
genericReactions.testimonial: I heard what Peter shouted. Then I felt the blade. Then... a touch.
genericReactions.digital: The arrest warrant was legal. What happened next was not.
genericReactions.environmental: It was dark in the garden. I remember the smell of olive trees and blood.
genericReactions.analytical: One moment, a wound. The next, nothing. How do you account for that?
genericReactions.prophecy: I serve the High Priest. I do not deal in prophecy. But I know what I felt.
